bio_en: Yeghishe Ishkhanian was born in Shushi, the son of Ivan-bek, a Russian state official from Ghshlagh in Khachen, and joined the ARF as a youth. A pupil activist who published and distributed a secret school weekly, he was soon trusted to work in the party's arms depots, attracting the attention of the Russian gendarmerie. He took part in the struggles for Karabakh, including the events of 1918. He later lived in the USA and died in New York in 1975.
